cards.name: Brush Strokes
cards.summary: Smears the layer into short directional brush strokes along a stroke angle; on a 1920x1080 frame even the harvested maxima (Brush Size 5, Stroke Length 40, Stroke Density 2) only give a subtle smeared, jagged-edged texture, so a clearly painted look needs the effect on a scaled-down precomp.
use_for: painted-portrait treatment for a historical figure in a documentary
stylized flashback or memory sequence
artistic still-photo background behind a title card
transition into an illustrated/painted segment
avoid: faces and small text turn to mush at large Brush Size / Stroke Length
strokes 'boil' on moving footage because they are rebuilt from the image every frame; best on stills or slow moves
looks like a cheap Photoshop filter when used full strength on a whole edit

at 1920x1080 the harvested maxima (Brush Size 5, Stroke Length 40, Stroke Density 2) still read as a soft smear at preview size (verified render); for a visible painting apply it inside a precomp scaled down (e.g. 50%) and scale back up (untested), and push contrast/saturation
long strokes pull a black jagged fringe in from outside the layer along the frame edges (left and top in the Stroke Length 40 render); scale the layer slightly past the frame or crop the edges

params.name: Brush Size
params.typical: 1-3 barely visible at 1080p; 5 is the max and still subtle at 1080p

params.name: Stroke Density
params.does: how many strokes cover the frame

params.name: Blend With Original
params.does: mix back the unprocessed image (0-1 fraction)

cards.equivalent: Brush Strokes (Premiere Stylize, current in v26; same engine, match AE.ADBE Brush Strokes)
cards.scripting: Paint Surface is a 4-item popup (1-based). Blend With Original harvested range is 0-1, so pass a fraction (0.3 = 30%), not 0-100. Stroke Angle is degrees with no harvested limit. Checkbox-like/popup values are numbers.

verified.note: Stroke texture is stronger than the old render (jagged diagonal streaks now show on the stripes, block edges and hair) but at preview size the frame still reads as a soft smeared image rather than a painting, faces stay intact, and the maxed Stroke Length now drags a black jagged fringe in along the left and top frame edges that the old render did not have.

cards.name: CC Block Load
cards.summary: Simulates a progressive-JPEG style image load: the layer builds up as large blocks that refine pass by pass into the full-resolution picture as Completion rises to 100.
use_for: 'image loading' reveal of a screenshot, document or leaked photo in a news explainer
digital/tech transition into a photo
retro dial-up internet gag in an AI-education reel
reveal of a leader's photo in a political explainer
avoid: static Completion below 100 just looks like low-res footage
too slow a load drags the pace; keep the reveal under ~1.5 s
a linear 0 -> 100 Completion keyframe spends ~90% of the move on 1-4 px passes that read as the finished image; ease or hold the low values

params.name: Completion
params.typical: keyframe 0 -> 100; the visible coarse-block phase is only the first ~10% (Scans 8)

params.name: Scans
params.does: number of refinement passes; first pass block = 2^(Scans-1) px, each pass halves it down to 1 px
params.typical: 7-9 on 1080p (4 starts at only 8 px blocks)

params.name: Bilinear
params.does: 1 = smooth blocks instead of hard pixels

cards.equivalent: Mosaic (Legacy) in Premiere with keyframed Horizontal/Vertical Blocks (low -> high) approximates the block-to-sharp refine, without the transparent build-up
cards.scripting: Start Cleared and Bilinear are 0/1 checkboxes. With Start Cleared on, Completion 0 is an empty frame. Completion is spent per block row, not per pass: pass j uses blocks of 2^(Scans-1-j) px sampled from the block's top-left pixel, loads top to bottom, and costs time proportional to its row count, so the 1 px pass takes the last ~50%, 2 px ~25-50%, 4 px ~12-25%, 8 px ~6-12%, 16 px ~3-6% (any Scans >= 6). Measured on aerender: Completion 40 / Scans 6 = 2 px blocks over 4 px with the scan line at y 688 of 1080 (looks untouched at preview size). For a static demo use Completion ~3-5 with Scans 8 (16/32 px blocks); for a reveal keyframe Completion 0 -> ~12 over most of the move, then snap to 100.

verified.note: The frame now reads clearly as a progressive image load, with ~16 px blocks above the scan line (about y 450 of 1080) and ~32 px blocks below it covering the whole picture, where the old Completion 40 render had 2-4 px blocks that looked untouched at preview size.

cards.name: CC Burn Film
cards.summary: Burns spreading holes through the layer like celluloid melting in a projector: dark scorched blotches grow out from around the Center and their cores become transparent.
use_for: burn-out ending of an archival / old-footage segment in a documentary
transition from a historic photo to the next shot
vintage 'film reel' flashback in a trailer
dramatic reveal of the layer underneath
avoid: burnt area is transparent: with nothing below it shows black/comp background
a static mid-burn frame looks like damage, animate it
Center on a face burns the face first
cards.equivalent: none in Premiere 2026; use a film-burn overlay clip in Screen/Add blend mode
cards.scripting: Place another layer (next shot or a warm-colour solid) below to see through the burn. Center is [x, y] px in a 1920x1080 comp.

verified.note: Several dark scorched burn blotches with black (transparent) cores eat through the frame around the centre, darkening the whole shot like melting celluloid.

cards.name: CC Glass
cards.summary: Turns the layer into a lit, refracting glass surface: a bump map (the layer itself by default) adds height, specular highlights and displacement so the image looks embossed under glass.
use_for: glassy embossed logo or title over a background
liquid/glass distortion texture for an abstract background
stylized 'under glass' treatment of a still in an AI-education reel
animated light sweep across an embossed graphic
avoid: on busy live-action the relief is noisy and faces distort
high Displacement smears the image beyond recognition
low Softness on detailed or noisy footage gives a crunchy, noisy relief; blur the bump source or raise Softness

params.name: Bump Map
params.does: layer whose values give surface height (default = this layer)
params.typical: leave as self or a blurred matte/text layer

params.name: Softness
params.does: blurs the bump map, smoother relief

params.name: Light Direction
params.does: angle of the distant light in degrees

pairs_with: Fast Box Blur (on the bump layer)
cards.scripting: Bump Map is a layer reference and cannot be set from a spec; default 1 means the effect layer itself, which works without another layer. Property (1-6) picks which channel of the bump map drives height; 1 Red, 2 Green, 3 Blue, 4 Alpha, 5 Luminance, 6 Lightness (default) (read from After Effects 26.0). Light Position only matters for Light Type 2 (point light). Light Color is #RRGGBB. Using 2 needs AE light layers in the comp.

verified.note: Image turned into a bright, refracting embossed glass relief with white specular rims on the figures, stripes and foreground blocks.

cards.name: CC HexTile
cards.summary: Rebuilds the frame as a honeycomb of hexagonal tiles, each tile repeating the image area around the centre, giving a hex-mosaic / insect-eye pattern.
use_for: tech/AI honeycomb background for an explainer title
hex-pixel transition between shots (animate Radius)
stylized data/network motif behind lower thirds
abstract music-reel visual
avoid: small Radius on faces or flags makes the subject unreadable
Smearing at extremes produces muddy streaks

params.name: Rotate
params.does: rotation of the hex grid in degrees

params.name: Lock Center Tile
params.does: 1 = keeps the centre tile showing the original area

cards.scripting: Render: 1 Tile (default), 2 Fold Aligned, 3 Fold Seamlessly (read from After Effects 26.0). Lock Center Tile is 0/1. Radius min is 3; very small values are slow and noisy. Rotate is degrees with no harvested limit.

verified.note: Frame rebuilt as a honeycomb of large hexagons, each repeating the centre area (sky and a striped edge) of the shot.

cards.name: CC Kaleida
cards.summary: Kaleidoscope: mirrors a wedge of the image around a centre point in one of several mirror patterns, producing symmetrical trippy imagery.
use_for: abstract looping background behind a title or quote card
psychedelic dream / confusion beat in a satire reel
transition by animating Size or Rotation
music-driven montage visual
avoid: destroys recognisability of people and flags, never on a factual news shot
very small Size gives high-frequency detail that compresses badly on Instagram

params.name: Size
params.does: size of the mirrored segment; larger = bigger, simpler pattern (units unverified, default 20 is fairly fine)

params.name: Floating Center
params.does: changes how moving Center affects the sampled image area (exact behaviour unverified)

cards.scripting: Mirroring: 1 Unfold, 2 Wheel, 3 Fish Head, 4 Can Meas, 5 Flip Flop, 6 Flower (default, the rendered demo), 7 Dia Cross, 8 Flipper, 9 Starlish (read from After Effects 26.0). Size units are not verified (it may scale with the layer, not raw px), so check the look before committing; 1 is the minimum. Floating Center is 0/1. Rotation is degrees, no harvested limit.

verified.note: Symmetrical kaleidoscope pattern of mirrored copies of a face and a small star-shaped wedge tiled across the frame.

cards.name: CC Mr. Smoothie
cards.summary: Replaces the image with smooth flowing colour bands: it samples the colours along a line between Sample A and Sample B and maps them onto the frame by a property (e.g. luminance) of the flow layer, giving a psychedelic liquid-colour look.
use_for: animated psychedelic background (animate Phase)
abstract colour-wash transition
stylized 'trip' / dream beat in a satire reel
motion background behind a quote card
avoid: completely loses the original picture, useless where the subject must be recognised
Smoothness near 0 gives harsh noisy banding

params.name: Flow Layer
params.does: layer whose values drive the colour mapping (default = this layer)

params.name: Property
params.does: which channel of the flow layer is used (popup, 8 options)

params.name: Smoothness
params.does: how smooth the colour transitions are

params.name: Sample A
params.does: start point of the colour sampling line (px)

params.name: Sample B
params.does: end point of the colour sampling line (px)

params.name: Color Loop
params.does: how many times the sampled palette repeats (popup, 4)

cards.scripting: Flow Layer is a layer reference and cannot be set from a spec; default 1 means the effect layer itself, which is enough to see the effect. Property (1 Red, 2 Green, 3 Blue, 4 Alpha, 5 Luminance (default), 6 Lightness, 7 Hue, 8 Saturation) and Color Loop (1 AB, 2 BA, 3 ABA, 4 BAB) are read from After Effects 26.0. Sample A/B are px points; put them on colourful areas (e.g. saturated stripes) for a vivid palette.

verified.note: Picture replaced by smooth liquid magenta, grey and pale-blue colour bands that follow the original shapes, a psychedelic colour-wash look.

cards.name: CC Plastic
cards.summary: Lights the layer as a glossy plastic or metal surface using a bump layer (the layer itself by default), giving embossed relief with specular highlights and optional dust.
use_for: glossy embossed logo / title plate
shiny plastic text for a playful AI-education reel
stylized relief texture on a still for a background
animated light sweep across a badge or emblem
avoid: on live-action faces the relief looks like skin disease
high Height with low Softness on detailed footage gives a crunchy, noisy relief

params.name: Bump Layer
params.does: layer whose values give surface height (default = this layer)
params.typical: self or a blurred text/matte layer

pairs_with: Fast Box Blur (on the bump layer)
cards.scripting: Bump Layer is a layer reference and cannot be set from a spec; default 1 = the effect layer itself. Property picks the bump channel: 1 Red, 2 Green, 3 Blue, 4 Alpha, 5 Luminance (default), 6 Lightness (read from After Effects 26.0). Light Position default is [480, 270] (quarter frame) and only matters for Light Type 2. Light Color / Ambient Light Color are #RRGGBB. Cut Min/Max clip the bump range (0-100).

verified.note: Whole image embossed into a glossy plastic relief with bright specular highlights along every edge while keeping the original colours.

cards.name: CC RepeTile
cards.summary: Extends the layer beyond its own edges by tiling copies of it (mirrored, repeated, brick etc.) to the right, left, top and bottom.
use_for: fill a 16:9 frame behind a vertical phone clip or portrait photo with mirrored copies (Tiling 4, Unfold)
add edge room so a zoom-out, rotation or camera shake shows no black borders
tiled video-wall background for news intros
infinite-scroll pattern background
avoid: on a full-frame layer at 100% scale the extension is outside the comp, nothing visible
mirrored seams are obvious on faces/text at the edges

params.name: Expand Right
params.does: px of tiling added to the right

params.name: Expand Left
params.does: px of tiling added to the left

params.name: Tiling
params.does: tile pattern (popup (read from After Effects 26.0)): 1 Repeat (default), 2 Checker Flip H, 3 Checker Flip V, 4 Unfold (mirrored), 5 Checker 180 deg, 6 Checker Flip 45 deg, 7 / 8 Checker 90 deg CCW / CW, 9 Rosette, 10 Random, 11 None, 12 a separator, 13 Turn CW, 14 Turn CCW, 15 Twist, 16 Slide, 17 Brick
params.typical: 4 (Unfold) for mirrored edges; 1 (Repeat) for a video wall

cards.scripting: Only visible when the layer is smaller than the comp or moved/scaled/rotated: on a full-frame 1920x1080 layer at 100% the tiles land outside the comp, so the demo frame on the full-frame gallery clip looks unchanged (expected, not a failure). In real use scale the layer to ~40-50% or use a vertical clip. Expand values are layer pixels. Default Tiling 1 is Repeat; the mirrored mode is 4 Unfold (labels (read from After Effects 26.0)). Blend Borders is 0/1. Put it first in the stack, before Transform / scale effects.

verified.note: Frame is the untouched clip: the gallery layer is full-frame 1920x1080 at 100%, so all tiles land outside the comp and no demo_settings value can bring them into view (needs a scaled-down or vertical layer).

previous.why: the harness lacked the setup it needs (see note)

cards.name: CC Threshold
cards.summary: Converts the image to pure black and white at a chosen threshold level (based on a selected channel), giving a stark photocopy / stencil look.
use_for: stark photocopy / xerox treatment of a newspaper clipping or document
stencil-style poster look for a satire title card
make a quick luma matte for a track matte
Blend w. Original at ~0.5 for a gritty contrast punch
avoid: faces lose all detail at a bad threshold; check skin tones
flickers on footage with changing exposure

params.name: Threshold
params.does: cut-off level; above = white, below = black (0-1)

cards.equivalent: no Threshold effect in the harvested Premiere 2026 list; approximate with Black & White followed by Posterize (Level 2)
pairs_with: Fast Box Blur (before, for smooth edges)
cards.scripting: Threshold and Blend w. Original are 0-1 fractions (not 0-255 / 0-100). Channel: 1 Luminance (default), 2 RGB, 3 Saturation, 4 Alpha (read from After Effects 26.0). Invert is 0/1.

verified.note: Image reduced to stark pure black and white stencil shapes (figures, foreground blocks and stripe outlines black on white).

cards.name: CC Threshold RGB
cards.summary: Thresholds the red, green and blue channels separately, reducing the image to the eight pure primary/secondary colours for a loud posterized pop-art look.
use_for: pop-art / screenprint treatment of a leader photo in a satire reel
loud stylized flash frame on a beat
retro poster background for a title
glitchy colour punch in a transition
avoid: skin turns red/magenta blotches; unflattering for portraits
too garish for serious news or documentary
cards.equivalent: Posterize (Premiere Stylize) at Level 2 gives the same 8-colour result with a fixed 50% cut-off per channel
cards.scripting: All thresholds and Blend w. Original are 0-1 fractions. The Invert * Channel props are 0/1 checkboxes.

verified.note: Image posterized to loud flat primaries and secondaries (red foreground blocks, yellow/green/cyan background, white/black figures), a pop-art screenprint look.

cards.name: CC Vignette
cards.summary: Darkens (or with negative Amount, brightens) the frame edges with a lens-like falloff around a movable centre, optionally protecting highlights.
use_for: pull the eye to the speaker in an interview or press shot
moody cinematic grade in a documentary or trailer
darken edges behind lower-third and caption areas
negative Amount for a soft bright dreamy edge
avoid: applied to a 16:9 source that is later reframed/panned inside a 9:16 comp, the vignette ends up off-centre; put it on an adjustment layer in the final comp
obvious dark corners look amateur; keep it subtle in news

params.name: Angle of View
params.does: how far the falloff reaches into the frame (degrees)

cards.equivalent: Lumetri Color (Vignette section) or the Premiere 2026 Vignette effect
cards.scripting: Center is [x, y] px in a 1920x1080 comp; move it onto the subject for off-centre framing. Amount range is -1000..1000; values above ~200 crush the edges to black.

verified.note: Strong dark lens falloff: corners crushed to near black while the centre of the frame keeps its original brightness.
